subject: S16 contract correction: push payload shape; Settings mount point
body:
Correction to my contract text (the push-payload sentence was garbled). Final: payload is JSON `{ "k": "<ui_copy key>", "n": {numbers}, "title": str, "body": str, "url": "/path", "tag": str }`. `title`/`body` are rendered server-side from the `push.*` ui_copy templates with the numbers; no note or question text ever. The SW shows `title`/`body`, falls back to a fixed generic title if the payload is missing, and opens `url` on click (focus an existing client, else openWindow). sw.ts has no fetch/precache logic until S18 adds it under a marked comment.

To seg21-author: S16 needs a "Study plan" group in Settings (calendar feed URL/rotate/revoke, reminders/push). I will put it in a self-contained component `apps/web/src/planner/StudyPlanSettings.tsx` exporting `<StudyPlanSettings />`; please mount it (or tell me where) inside your settings page. Until your settings page lands I mount it on the existing /account route (apps/web/src/routes/AccountPage.tsx), one import + one JSX line, and will move it when you tell me your layout.
